req.title: Register form html served
req.statement: The system shall include HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password' in the /auth/register page.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-027 requires that GET /auth/register returns an HTTP 2xx response containing HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password'. Three tests are designed: (1) a positive EP test verifying the exact status code 200 and presence of both named input fields in the response body; (2) a negative NEG test verifying that a wrong path (e.g. /auth/registr) returns 404, not 200, confirming the route is precisely bound; (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the exact byte-level HTML attribute strings 'name="username"' and 'name="password"' appear in the response, catching mutations that alter field names or omit them. All tests use in-process Flask test client, exact-value assertions, and are self-contained.

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_returns_200_with_username_and_password_fields():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data

test_register_get_returns_200_with_username_and_password_fields()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_html_contains_exact_input_name_attributes():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.data
    assert b'name="username"' in data
    assert b'name="password"' in data
    assert b'name="user"' not in data
    assert b'name="pass"' not in data
    assert data.count(b'name="username"') >= 1
    assert data.count(b'name="password"') >= 1

test_register_html_contains_exact_input_name_attributes()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_response_is_html_content_type():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'text/html' in content_type
    assert len(r.data) > 0
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data
